subject: general
question: When used for fits between shaft and hole, __________is specified or both shaft and hole.

options.text: the hole size is more than the shaft size
the shaft size is more than the hole size

solution:
The correct answer is __the same basic size.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The same basic size__ is specified for both the shaft and the hole when used for fits.
 
• This ensures a precise and standardized fit between the two components.
 
• It is a critical factor in the design and manufacturing of mechanical parts for proper functioning.
 
• Adopting the same basic size minimizes errors and misalignment in the assembly process.
 
• It helps in achieving interchangeability of parts in production and maintenance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Clearance Fit:**

 
 
• In a clearance fit, the hole is always larger than the shaft, ensuring free movement.
 
• This type of fit is commonly used in applications where relative motion is required.
 
 
 
• **Interference Fit:**
 
 
• In an interference fit, the shaft is slightly larger than the hole, creating a tight assembly.
 
• This type of fit is used for applications requiring a fixed and secure connection.
 
 
 
• **Transition Fit:**
 
 
• A transition fit may result in either a clearance or an interference, depending on the tolerances.
 
• It is used in applications requiring both precision and flexibility.
